claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says Ripple-65B Preview achieves U.S. open-weight state-of-the-art (80.52) on TerminalBench 2.1.
claims.excerpt: achieving U.S. open-weight state-of-the-art (80.52) on TerminalBench 2.1 and surpassing significantly larger US open-weight models

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says Ripple-65B Preview scores higher on TerminalBench 2.1 than Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open 816B (76.4), Thinking Machines Inkling 975B (63.8) and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (56.4).
claims.excerpt: surpassing significantly larger US open-weight models such as Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open 816B (76.4), Thinking Machines Inkling 975B (63.8), and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (56.4).

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says it trained Ripple-65B Preview for only $32M in full R&D cost, one-tenth the cost of the previous open-weight SOTA on agentic coding, by its own estimate.
claims.excerpt: we developed and trained Ripple-65B Preview for only $32M, which is one-tenth the cost of the previous open-weight SOTA on agentic coding, as estimated to the best of our knowledge.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says Ripple-65B Preview is pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length.
claims.excerpt: The model is pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview as a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model that powers its AI chip design platform.
claims.excerpt: Today, we release Ripple-65B Preview, a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model that powers our AI chip design platform.

claims.claim_text: Ripple-65B Preview is available on Hugging Face, Together AI, GMI Cloud, OpenRouter, and Fireworks.
claims.excerpt: Ripple-65B Preview is available on Hugging Face, Together AI, GMI Cloud, OpenRouter, and Fireworks.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says it chose a dense Transformer architecture over Mixture-of-Experts and reached about 40% MFU during pretraining and posttraining.
claims.excerpt: we chose to train a modernized dense Transformer model rather than use Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) like other labs.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says its final model ladder can reach similar code performance to the Olmo 3 ladder with 16x less compute, measured by dolma_stack CE at 4B scale.
claims.excerpt: our final Ripple model ladder can be used to achieve similar code performance to the Olmo 3 ladder with 16x less compute.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence says it reached a TerminalBench 2.1 score of 80.5 using only 1.4M rollouts, roughly 70x fewer than Reflection Beam.
claims.excerpt: We reached a TerminalBench 2.1 score of 80.5 with only 1.4M rollouts, roughly 70x fewer rollouts than Reflection Beam, the prior SOTA.
